# vendor/models

- `Xbot.glb` — Mixamo "X Bot" character (Adobe Mixamo), as redistributed in the three.js examples
  (`examples/models/gltf/Xbot.glb`, three.js commit 2016416). Mixamo characters and animations are
  royalty-free for use in personal and commercial projects. Used here as an anatomically proportioned
  mannequin driven by pose landmarks; the bundled animation clips are not used.
